Class Nip59

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.nip59.Nip59
public final class Nip59 extends Object
Creates and opens NIP-59 gift wraps containing unsigned rumor events. The author signs an encrypted seal; a fresh disposable key signs the outer envelope. Unwrapping verifies both signatures and the rumor's author and event ID binding. Publishing, relay selection, inbox filtering and retention remain the caller's responsibility.

  • Method Details

    • isGiftWrap

      public static boolean isGiftWrap(NostrEvent event)
      Identifies regular and ephemeral gift-wrap envelopes by their event kind. This does not verify signatures, recipient tags or encrypted contents. Use unwrap() to validate and decrypt an envelope before trusting its rumor.
      Parameters:
      event - event to classify, or null
      Returns:
      whether the event has a supported gift-wrap kind

    • wrap

      public static org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<SignedNostrEvent> wrap(NostrSigner sender, UnsignedNostrEvent event, NostrPublicKey recipient)
      Encrypts an unsigned event for one recipient, using a fresh outer key. To retain sent messages, wrap the same event independently for the sender. The input event is cloned before asynchronous work starts. Outer keys are destroyed after success or failure, and no event is published by this method.
      Parameters:
      sender - caller-owned signer for the rumor author and its seal
      event - unsigned rumor whose content and tags are retained
      recipient - public key that can decrypt the gift wrap
      Returns:
      signed kind-1059 envelope ready for caller-controlled publication

    • unwrap

      public static org.ngengine.platform.AsyncTask<Map<String,Object>> unwrap(NostrSigner recipient, SignedNostrEvent giftWrap)
      Verifies both signatures, recipient, inner event ID and author binding. The returned immutable rumor deliberately has no signature. Never publish it. Both regular and ephemeral gift wraps are accepted. The recipient tag must match exactly once; malformed envelopes and failed bindings reject the returned task.
      Parameters:
      recipient - caller-owned signer that decrypts the envelope and seal
      giftWrap - signed outer envelope addressed to the recipient
      Returns:
      immutable unsigned rumor map after all validation has completed
